scope: Every currently displayed Key Risks card in ordinary production HTML, metric. Selection and icon mapping are unit-independent. No PDF generation.

criteria.keep: Direct match or useful general symbol for the correct subject/process; not diagnostic/species-perfect.

criteria.missing: No icon resolved for the displayed label.

decisions_are: AI editorial/visual judgements for John’s review, informed by live crop prose and selected primary-source checks. Not new artwork approvals.
